events.title: 리버풀 beat 리즈 유나이티드 1–0 at Anfield to move six points behind the Yorkshire side with two games in hand. At the other end of the table, 맨체스터 유나이티드's relegation problems continue as they lose 1–0 to 버밍엄 시티, who also remain in the bottom three.
리즈 유나이티드 lose 3–1 at 웨스트햄 유나이티드, their third league defeat in a row, handing control of the title race to 리버풀, who are now four points behind with three games in hand.
